Name: Dogs of The SNES
Author: cryomancer199x
Description:
So I've been working on this one in the background for a long time. It stalled for months for reasons. Thankfully situations changed and I am now able to actually release this beast unto the world. Initially, this was meant to be an update for my previous mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24393]Dogs of Evermore[/url], but as I kept feeding into feature creep it sort of changed so much that I felt it wise to just make it a whole new mod. All content from that mod is also in this one, in some form. The Prehistoria dogs no longer do bones, but the Howlers now will. You CAN in fact use both at once if you want to, I don't think there's much reason to do so tho. You'll get some duplicate content if you do, but it shouldn't break. Probably.

So, what all do you get in this new version?

A fancy new Dog Kennel building. It has a base and an upgraded form. You will need the upgraded form to get every variety of dog. When inside the building, hay will become dog kibble, and the hay hopper will be a bag of food. The bowls are the feed spots. Upgraded Kennel has auto-feeding and a built in heater.

This mod was made intended for use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]﻿, although you can use it without. For vanilla, Evermore and Mana dogs will pick a random one of 5, and you'll just have to buy the base Earthbound Dog and hope for alternates once you've hit their unlock requirement. With LB active you can instead choose any you have unlocked, and even any color you prefer. I believe the dogs will only reproduce into the same dogs, testing on that has been slim however. I may overhaul that in the future to make some sort of breed-to-upgrade kind of situation but that might be beyond me. tl;dr vanilla for random chance at store, LB for picking your preference.
[size=4]
[b][color=#ff7700]Dogs of Evermore, artifact hunters[/color][/b][/size]
5 colors of Prehistoria Dire Wolf that each produce Stone and different Prehistoric artifacts
5 colors of Antiqua Pharaoh Hound  that each produce Arrowheads and different Ancient artifacts
5 colors of Gothica Poodle that each produce Glass Shards and different Medieval artifacts
No Toaster Dog....for now. But you can kind of get those in my other mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25568]Toast of the Town[/url].

[b][color=#00ff00][size=4]Howlers of Mana, bone hunters[/size][/color][/b]
5 colors of Howler that produce Bone Fragments and different Bone artifacts

[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Earthbound Dogs, mineral hunters[/size][/color][/b]
At first you will only be able to get one kind, there are ten total. As you progress in the mines and (some other conditions), more will become available to you, purchased from the same store entry as the initial one.
Here's a list if you don't mind being spoiled, but you can probably guess roughly what they do anyway

[spoiler]
Earthbound Dog (aka Runaway Dog) Clay and Earth Crystals
Copper Wolf - Copper Ore and Quartz
Silver Wolf - Silver Ore and Amethyst
Gold Wolf - Gold Ore and Ruby
Carbon Dog - Coal and Fire Quartz
Desert Wolf - Jade and Topaz. You can also sometimes harvest cactus from it with shears.
Chilly Dog - Frozen Tear and Aquamarine
Diamond Dog - Iridium Ore and Diamond
Atomic Dog - Radioctive Ore and Emerald
Magicant Dog - Cinder Shards and Dragon Teeth

Copper, Silver, and Gold Wolves only have one color each.
For reference, I made some of these up for purposes of the mod. Silver Wolf exists in Mother 1 but the Copper and Gold don't. Desert Wolf combines two similar wolves from 2 and 3. Atomic Dog and Magicant Dog are made up for this mod. Currently, Carbon cannot turn into Diamond, I'm not sure if there's a smart way to even do that.
[/spoiler]

[b][color=#ffff00][size=4]Pets[/size][/color][/b]
A vanilla reskin based on Evermore's dog pre-transformation
The Gothica and Antiqua dogs in default colors
Diamond Dog in default color
Boney from Mother 3

[b][size=4]Some dogs may be[color=#ff0000] dangerous to touch or be near[/color], or even [color=#00ff00]beneficial to be near[/color].[/size][/b]
All Earthbound Dogs have puppy art, the others do not. Most dogs have 5 color variants each, although all colors produce the same things.

Future plans: 
King from Earthbound in some form
Golden Animal Crackers for optional alternate produce (hopefully with alternate graphics too)
Dogs from Metal Max
Probably re-doing the flames effect for a third or forth time and still not loving it

Is the current structure confusing or obnoxious? I am open to feedback. Considering breaking the EB dogs into at least two animals, but for now they are all technically one.

Optional Mod features, if you have the linked mods as well:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1538]Animal Husbandry[/url]- Treat Press machine that will make dog treats to give to your dogs. I did not make dog meat. Most dogs will accept the added biscuits, bone items, or meat. Howlers will not accept the bone items they make, but will accept Ginger Island fossil bones.
[b][size=4]
